$comment: AgOps multi-agent coordination. Every hook here is deterministic (a script,
never a model call) and every one fails OPEN: if the coordinator is broken,
sessions still start and edits still land. See .agops/README.md.
SessionStart  register this session as an agent, brief it on the team
PreToolUse    block a write into a file another LIVE agent's task owns
Stop          heartbeat, deliver messages, surface the next task
SessionEnd    mark offline, free resource locks, KEEP task ownership
statusLine    which agent this window is, its task, locks and unread count
